notes.title: Prepare for the 4.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! This is Kiapigeon, the creator of The Last Duskreaper. I was very busy recently and I apologize for my lack of activity. I know the game hasn’t been updated much lately but it’s also because I’m saving everything for a big update that should not take a lot of time, the 4.0. This update will be accompanied by a brand new zone and a lot of major gamedesign changes for an even more captivating, dynamic and pleasant experience. It will also be the update that I will promote by several ways and the one that will fix many bugs. 

So this is THE update not to be missed! It should arrive in the coming months if there are no problems.  To conclude, as usual, I wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper!

notes.title: 3.5 - Video update
notes.notes: Hello everybody! As you noticed, I didn't make any big update recentely since I am really busy right now. But I finally finished The Last Duskreaper's intro cinematic ! It was a long labour and I was working on the "Golden Alex" version too, for a small videogame contest. Anyway, it was the first time I've made a video project of such scale and it was really funny to create. Hope you'll find this little animation as good as I think it is! A new gameplay video should replace the old and outdated one on the game's steam store page. And as usual, I wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper.

notes.title: 3.4 - New Zone, Bugs and Dodge
notes.notes:
[u]Hello everyone! I noticed a lot of bugs in the previous version! And on the other hand, I made a big change to the combat system and added a preview of the next zone. So here is the 3.4 and its additions:[/u]

[b]FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a dodge move (K+J)
[*] Added a system displaying the date and time of each file
[*] Added a small portion of the next area. Probably not representative of the entire area
[*] Best Player Racing Animations
[*] Added a "backup" function to never lose your files
[/list]

[b]BUGS PATCHED: [/b]
[list]
[*] Corner Jump Glitch Fixed - bug that stops the player from jumping against a corner of a wall
[*] Data Eater Fixed - bug causing sudden overwriting of a save file
[*] Slope Soft Lock Fixed - soft locking bugthat occurs when the player was performing a ground pound on a slope
[*] Title Auto Keys Fixed - bug always showing the controls menu at game launch
[*] Roll Block Stop Fixed - bug stopping an attack at every contact with a breakable wall
[*] Level Up Soft Lock Fixed - game crash during level up
[*] Power Menu FPS Drop Fixed - bug causing FPS tdrop when opening the power menu
[*] Start new game black flash - bug making appear a black flash at the beginning of each game
[/list]

[b]KNOWN BUGS :[/b]
[list]
[*] Slowatch Start Bug - bug causing FPS drop each time slow mode is engaged
[*] Music Start Bug - bug causing a delay during transitions between tutorial musics
[/list]

[u]And that’s it for today! If you find other bugs, don’t hesitate to share them with me via discord or steam. Thank you all. And as usual, I wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper.[/u]

notes.title: 3.2-Opti Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I had some negative feedback about the game because of its lag. This new update tries to solve this problem with a new system to optimize resources. 

I thank you for your patience and wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper!

notes.title: The Last Duskreaper 3.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Following the 3.0 release, I decided to change some small details. Here is the 3.1 and what it changes:
[list]
[*] Upgraded graphisms
[*] Small slow-motion mode related bugs fix
[*] Finally changed checkpoints
[*] Default controller support and preset input table
[*] New prologue end boss
[/list]

And that’s it for today! Thank you all. And as usual, I wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper.

notes.title: How to use your controller with the game
notes.notes:
Hello, I come to you because I have seen many people complain about the game's catastrophic controller support. So I removed it by default. But you can still assign controller keys to the game: that's how. 

By pressing esc in the game, you will be able to access the settings. Then, from the input menu, select your controller. You will just have to assign each buttons of your controller to the buttons starting with the ">" sign at the bottom of the list.

I hope you will enjoy the controller support in the game. I thank Hawk Zombie for his review of the game. Sorry for all the problems. I wish you a pleasant experience on The Last Duskreaper.

notes.title: The Last Duskreaper 3.0 !
notes.notes:
The 3.0 is now out ! And, by the way, the Prologue is finished ! I will soon start working on the chapter 1. Here is a list of all the major changes of the game :

[list]
[*] -Slow motion mode for tricky platform moments
[*] -Minor bug patchs
[*] -Multi-language title screen
[*] -Developped story in the first part of the prologue
[*] -Data destroyer bug patched
[*] -Better decoration of all the zones currently accessible
[*] -Stamina regeneration speed buffed
[*] -All Ashley sprites improved
[/list]

Thank you for waiting and I wish you a good experience in The Last Duskreaper!

notes.title: Where is "The Last Duskreaper" at ?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I’m Kiapigeon, the creator of The Last Duskreaper. I am here today to give you an update on the status of the game and to announce an update.

First, I am really proud of this game and I love working on it. My ambitious goal is to create a great metroidvania which graphics, code, music, marketing and everything the game contains would be created by me. So you probably understand why I take so long to make a little update.

On the other hand, I have never had any real marketing experience and I try to get by as best I can. So I apologize for the lack of news about the game but I am constantly working on the game on my side, even if I'm not giving feedback anywhere.

An update with, for example, an easy mode and a more in-depth story from the first hour of the game should soon arrive, if all goes well. Thank you for waiting and I wish you a good experience in The Last Duskreaper!
